title: Reclamation dirty worktree disk safety and idempotent evidence archives
description: Fix Ralph worktree reclamation so completed/integrated dirty worktrees are safely archived once and reclaimed according to target-sync-specific retention, while retry/manual-review dirty worktrees remain conservative and evidence/log growth is bounded.
policyApprovalsRequired: Do not enqueue automatically while intake/queue gates are blocked by the existing integration_sync_conflict.
Operator may explicitly choose to apply/adapt this PRD after queue gates are clear or by intentional override.

userStories.title: Clean terminal worktrees are aggressively reclaimed
userStories.story: As Shawn, I want clean completed/terminal Ralph worktrees removed promptly so they do not consume disk after integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Clean terminal task worktrees continue to use remove_clean with force=false.
Clean terminal reclamation still validates the task is terminal, not active or leased, inside .ralph-worktrees, and still clean immediately before removal.
Existing cleanup CLI dry-run semantics continue to report wouldRemove without deleting.

userStories.title: Dirty completed integrated worktrees reclaim by safe target-sync class
userStories.story: As Shawn, I want dirty completed/integrated worktrees to be archived once and reclaimed after a short safe TTL based on target sync status.
acceptanceCriteria: completed+integrated+targetSync=synced dirty worktrees default to archive_then_reclaim after 0 hours retention.
completed+integrated+targetSync=disabled dirty worktrees default to archive_then_reclaim after 24 hours retention.
completed+integrated+targetSync=deferred_dirty_checkout or failed remains archive_only in normal periodic mode until disk pressure and TTL safety gates allow reclaim.
completed tasks with integrationStatus failed or blocked_conflict are not blindly reclaimed by this change.

userStories.title: Evidence archive is idempotent and fingerprint-gated
userStories.story: As Shawn, I want repeated manager sweeps to reuse complete matching evidence instead of generating duplicate timestamped archives.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable evidence archive requires an existing managed manifest, complete=true, matching taskId/repoPath/worktree/kind, compatible decision, and matching dirty fingerprint.
The dirty fingerprint includes status porcelain, unstaged diff, cached diff, head/branch identity, and untracked file fingerprints where safe.
A changed dirty worktree fingerprint causes a new evidence archive rather than reusing stale evidence.
Before archive_then_reclaim removal, Ralph revalidates the current fingerprint still matches the manifest.

userStories.title: Disk pressure reclaims safe dirty completed integrated worktrees earlier
userStories.story: As Shawn, I want ordinary disk pressure to reclaim safe completed/integrated dirty worktrees before emergency disk exhaustion.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary under-pressure mode enables dirtyTerminalModeOverride=archive_then_reclaim, but ReclamationService downgrades non-eligible dirty terminal worktrees to archive_only.
Retry/manual_review dirty failed worktrees remain archive_only unless explicit manual abandon policy is used.
Emergency mode can still include dirty orphan reclaim, constrained by existing path/status/unmerged safety gates.

userStories.title: Reclamation evidence and report logs have bounded growth
userStories.story: As Shawn, I want successful dirty reclamation to prune duplicate evidence and rotate reclamation.jsonl so Ralph does not refill disk with its own cleanup artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful archive_then_reclaim, duplicate complete matching evidence for the same task/repo/worktree is pruned to reclamation.evidence.maxArchivesPerTask, default 1.
Pruning only deletes directories under the configured evidence root, skips .tmp, requires complete matching manifests, and preserves the current manifest.
reclamation.reporting.maxJsonlBytes and maxJsonlFiles rotate reclamation.jsonl before append; defaults are 50MiB and 5 rotated files.
No active, leased, non-terminal, unmerged, status-error, branch-unexpected, path-out-of-.ralph-worktrees, or user-source-outside-.ralph-worktrees worktree is deleted by normal automation.
Default dirtyTerminalMode remains archive_only globally; completed+integrated eligible dirty task worktrees are selectively promoted to archive_then_reclaim by effective decision logic.
keepNewestDirtyPerRepo protects dirty retry/manual_review/target_sync attention states, not already completed+integrated synced/disabled reclaimable worktrees.
Failed retry/manual_review dirty worktrees are not blindly removed by normal periodic or ordinary disk-pressure automation, but their evidence archive is idempotent.
Repeated manager sweeps over an unchanged dirty worktree reuse existing complete fingerprint-matching evidence and do not increment new archive counts.
If removal fails after successful archive, the next run can reuse the previous complete archive and retry removal without duplicating evidence.
After successful archive_then_reclaim removal, task state records worktreeReclaimedAt/ReclaimedBy/ReclaimDecision and current evidence manifest path best-effort.
reclamation.jsonl rotates before append when it exceeds reclamation.reporting.maxJsonlBytes.
The patch does not touch scheduler/queue/followup recovery logic or resolve the existing integration_sync_conflict.
rollbackSafetyNotes: Revert the patch before running manager if unexpected reclamation decisions appear in dry-run reports.

Evidence archives are only pruned after successful archive_then_reclaim and only under reclamation evidence root; rollback can disable pruning by setting reclamation.evidence.pruneDuplicateArchives=false.
Dirty under-pressure promotion can be disabled operationally by setting reclamation.worktrees.reclaimDirtyCompletedIntegratedUnderPressure=false.
JSONL rotation can be disabled by setting reclamation.reporting.maxJsonlBytes=0.
Do not manually delete dirty failed/manual_review worktrees during rollback unless an operator has inspected evidence and intentionally abandons them.

applyOrder: Apply config defaults and new reclamation/evidence/reporting settings in src/config/manager.ts.
Apply evidence fingerprint, managed manifest validation, duplicate prune support, and fingerprint-stable archive ID changes in src/core/reclamation-evidence.ts.
Apply effective dirty decision logic, reusable evidence, completed-integrated retention, safety-gate, prune, and JSONL rotation changes in src/core/reclamation.ts.
Apply ordinary disk-pressure dirty terminal override in src/core/dependency-watcher.ts.
Apply focused reclamation and dependency watcher tests.
assumptions: ConfigManager default config is the authoritative default source for reclamation settings.
Task.worktreeReclaimEvidenceManifestPath is a hint only; reusable evidence is trusted only after manifest, managed-path, candidate, decision, and fingerprint validation.
Dirty completed+integrated targetSync=disabled worktrees are safe to reclaim after the 24h default retention because target branch publication is intentionally disabled by policy.
Manual cleanup with explicit dirtyTerminalModeOverride remains an operator-intent path and is not made more restrictive by the normal automation safeguards.
knownRisks: Fingerprinting untracked files reads small files up to maxSingleUntrackedFileBytes and uses metadata for larger files, so extremely large untracked files may rely on size/time metadata rather than full content hashes.
If live code has diverged from the attached snippets, Ralph/Codex must adapt hunks while preserving acceptance criteria.
A task whose dirty evidence manifest path was never recorded cannot reuse prior archives until a new complete manifest is recorded in task state.
Tests use fake evidence archivers for decision behavior; real git evidence coverage remains in the existing real archive test and should be expanded if live code supports more fixture time.
dependencyRechecks: Confirm resolveTaskTargetSyncStatus still returns synced, disabled, deferred_dirty_checkout, failed, and not_requested with the same semantics.
Confirm ReclamationDecision.action names are unchanged: skip, retain, remove_clean, archive_only, archive_then_reclaim.
Confirm WorktreeManager methods used by computeDirtyFingerprint exist and preserve current signatures.
Confirm dependency watcher disk-pressure tests still inject statfs and reclamationService in the same constructor dependency shape.
rollbackNotes: If only runtime rollback is needed, set reclamation.worktrees.reclaimDirtyCompletedIntegratedUnderPressure=false and reclamation.evidence.pruneDuplicateArchives=false, then restart the manager.
Restore previous reclamation.reporting.maxJsonlBytes/maxJsonlFiles behavior by removing those keys or setting maxJsonlBytes=0 if rotation causes operational surprise.
Do not manually delete dirty failed/manual_review worktrees during rollback unless an operator has inspected evidence and intentionally abandons them.
